header.running_head: Conviction in the Promises of Allaah

When six years passed without the Romans attaining victory, the Mushrikeen took the payment from Hadhrat Abu Bakr (RA). However, it was when the seventh year entered that the Romans defeated the Persians. Some Muslims therefore criticised Hadhrat Abu Bakr (RA) for stipulating six years because Allaah had only mentioned "a few years" (without specifying). Nevertheless, (seeing that the Qur'aanic prediction was true) many people accepted Islaam on this occasion.[^1]
Hadhrat Baraa (RA) narrates that when the verses:

blocks.arabic_text: الٓمّٓ ۚ غُلِبَتِ الرُّوْمُ ۙ فِيْٓ اَدْنَى الْاَرْضِ وَهُمْ مِّنْۢ بَعْدِ غَلَبِهِمْ سَيَغْلِبُوْنَ
blocks.text: Alif Laam Meem (The people of) Rome will be defeated (by the Persians) in the (land that is) nearer (to the Arabs than the) land (of the Persians) and, after their defeat, (the Romans) will again be victorious.

were revealed, the Mushrikeen said to Hadhrat Abu Bakr (RA), "Don't you see what your master believes? He assumes that Rome will defeat Persia." Hadhrat Abu Bakr (RA) immediately replied, "My master is true." They then challenged Hadhrat Abu Bakr (RA) to a bet and specified a time period. When the time expired before Rome could defeat Persia and the news reached Rasulullaah ﷺ, he was displeased and asked Hadhrat Abu Bakr (RA), "What made you do this?" Hadhrat Abu Bakr (RA) replied, "To prove the veracity of Allaah and His Rasool ﷺ." Rasulullaah ﷺ advised him saying, "Now approach them to increase the bet and set the time for 'بضع' (a period anywhere between three and nine years)."
Hadhrat Abu Bakr (RA) then approached the Mushrikeen saying, "Would you like to renew the bet? The renewal is a better deal." They agreed. It was before the expiry of the (specified) years that Rome defeated Persia, set up a stronghold in Madaa'in and built the city of Roomiyya. (After collecting the payment) Hadhrat Abu Bakr (RA) came to Rasulullaah ﷺ with it saying, "This is unlawful (what should I do with it)." Rasulullaah ﷺ then told him to give it away as Sadaqah.[^2]
The Conviction of Hadhrat Ka'b bin Adi (RA) about the Domination of Islaam

Hadhrat Ka'b bin Adi (RA) says, "I came with a delegation from Heera to Nabi ﷺ. When Rasulullaah ﷺ presented Islaam to us, we accepted and then returned to Heera.
